title: Revit Keynote and Annotation Code Governed Fields

entries.name: Code system
entries.requirement: Each governed keynote or annotation-code profile shall identify whether it is specification-based, internally coded, or another approved controlled system.

entries.name: Master source identity
entries.requirement: The profile shall identify the controlled master data source used by Revit rather than relying on untracked local copies.

entries.name: Governance owner
entries.requirement: The profile shall identify the role responsible for maintenance of the controlled code source.

entries.name: Edit authority
entries.requirement: The profile shall identify which governed roles may modify the master code source.

entries.name: Version and archive basis
entries.requirement: Changes to the code source shall be versioned or otherwise traceable so historical project references remain interpretable.

entries.name: Annotation style reference
entries.requirement: The profile shall reference the approved annotation style used to display the keynote or code without embedding unresolved source-era formatting examples.

entries.name: Associativity requirement
entries.requirement: Where element- or material-associated keynoting is applicable, governed associative data shall be preferred over independent free text.

entries.name: Project deviation
entries.requirement: Any project-specific code list or deviation shall be identified, governed, and separated from the enterprise master source.

non_promoted_source_content: No source placeholder path, owner name, review cadence, graphic style, or code list is promoted as an approved enterprise value.

provenance.migration_note: Migrates keynote/code governance structure while preserving unresolved owner, path, cadence, and style values as future governed data.
